references.text: God spoke to Moses from Mount Sinai with fire and smoke, and the people heard his voice from heaven
The people saw and heard God's voice from the fire on Mount Sinai, and they were afraid
The Lord spoke to the people face to face on the mountain, right out of the fire
God spoke from the fire, cloud, and darkness, and the people heard his voice from heaven
God corrects and disciplines his people, just as a father disciplines his son
God comes with fire before him and reveals himself powerfully
The Lord lets his majestic voice be heard from heaven with consuming fire
God spoke from heaven at Sinai, and his voice shook the earth
Reference to the event at Sinai with the fire and God's voice that the people heard
